description: LH COSMIC is a team of three innovators united by curiosity, creativity, and a passion for space exploration. Combining science, technology, engineering, and design, we turn ambitious ideas into reality. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we are creating LH CRAFTS: LUNAR FRONTIER, an immersive lunar mission simulation featuring spacecraft engineering, scientific discovery, and cinematic storytelling. We dream big, push boundaries, and explore new possibilities. DREAM. DESIGN. EXPLORE.
